title: Bound compiled relation receipt catalogs before normalization
finding: CompiledRelationBlocks is a public revision-bound receipt with the same MAX_COMPILED_RELATIONS cardinality domain as compile_relation_blocks, but direct construction normalized tuple(self.blocks) before enforcing any catalog bound. An arbitrary iterable could therefore be consumed without a finite declared size, and an oversized sequence could be materialized before the receipt failed on later semantic checks.

implementation.summary: Validate blocks as a bounded Sequence and reject catalogs larger than MAX_COMPILED_RELATIONS before tuple normalization, sorting, duplicate-name checks, or block semantic validation. Existing compile_relation_blocks behavior and the canonical block representation remain unchanged; no second receipt, compiler, validator subsystem, cache, index, backend, registry, semantic plane, or public product surface was added.

focused_contracts: an oversized Sequence reports its declared cardinality and is rejected before item access or iteration
an iterable without a bounded Sequence contract is rejected before it can be consumed
existing compiler-produced tuple catalogs remain on the same canonical normalization and semantic-validation path

verification.diagnostic_profiles: Python 3.12/hash-0 CPU-bitset and TypedRelationBlock profiles completed; claim none

claims.correctness: compiled receipt catalogs now fail closed on unbounded or over-limit containers before normalization
claims.memory: boundedness contract only; no measured improvement claim
